title: あいかわらず
subtitle: N2
objectives: Learn the word «あいかわらず»

steps.title: あいかわらず
body: Today we focus on the word «あいかわらず» (aikawarazu).
It means: as ever / as usual / the same.

steps.title: About «あいかわらず»
body: «あいかわらず» (aikawarazu) means «as ever / as usual / the same».

paragraphs.text: 彼はあいかわらず丈夫だ。
paragraphs.hanzi: 彼はあいかわらず丈夫だ。
paragraphs.translation: He is as strong as ever.
paragraphs.translation_en: He is as strong as ever.
paragraphs.translation_id: He is as strong as ever.

exercise.prompt: What does «あいかわらず» mean?

options.label: as ever / as usual / the same

exercise.explanation: «あいかわらず» means «as ever / as usual / the same».

steps.title: Summary
body: «あいかわらず» (aikawarazu) = as ever / as usual / the same.
Practice this word in the reading exercises.
